text_field_note: No disagreement check on text fields. Disagreement checks run on locations, map sheets, divisions, metres and drill intervals.

fields.name: Location
fields.definition: Where the reports place the property or its centre of work, as coordinates.
fields.rule_text: Points within 5 km count as the same place, because each report gives its own centre of work to the nearest minute. Points farther apart are put on different sides.
fields.code_line: The nearest points on the two sides are 62.0 km apart (more than 5 km).

eval_cross_check.note: The same rule run over claims from the eval sessions. Listed only if they found something this field's session did not; the field's state above is unchanged.

fields.name: Map sheet
fields.definition: The NTS or BCGS map sheet the reports give for the property.
fields.rule_text: Map sheets are compared on the four-character NTS map area, such as 092P.

eval_cross_check.note: The same rule run over claims from the eval sessions. Listed only if they found something this field's session did not; the field's state above is unchanged.

fields.name: Mining division
fields.definition: The BC mining division the reports name for the property.
fields.rule_text: Values are compared as text, ignoring case, punctuation and the field's own label words.

fields.name: 2022 drilling
fields.definition: Diamond drilling done on the property in 2022: total metres drilled and the significant intervals reported.

parts.name: Total metres
parts.rule_text: Numbers within 0.1% of each other count as the same value, so rounding doesn't split them.

parts.name: Significant intervals
parts.rule_text: Two intervals for the same hole with the same copper and nickel grades and overlapping depths describe the same interval. Their widths disagree if they differ by more than 0.05 m. Code also checks that to minus from equals the stated width, allowing for how precisely each number is written.

fields.name: Resource estimate
fields.definition: A mineral resource or reserve estimate stated for the property, with tonnage and grade.
refusals: Searched all seven reports for 'mineral resource estimate', 'reserves', 'tonnes grading', 'million tonnes', 'inferred/indicated resource', 'NI 43-101 compliant', 'historical resource'. The only tonnage-and-grade resource or reserve figures are for other deposits used as analogues or regional context: Kevitsa in Finland (34595 p13, 36430 p16, 36807 p18), Aguablanca in Spain (34595 p16), and Woodjam inferred resources (36430 p17, 36807 p19). No resource or reserve estimate is stated for the Iron Lake property itself.
